journey.name: Shopping List - Toggle and Clear
journey.description: Test Shopping List tab: load items, toggle checkbox to mark purchased with strikethrough, clear purchased items

actions.action: Tap the "Shopping List" tab at the bottom of the screen
Verify the "Shopping List" title is visible
Check if shopping list items are displayed in a list
Tap the checkbox on the first shopping list item to mark it as purchased
Verify the first item text has strikethrough decoration indicating it is purchased
Verify the checked item has been removed from the list
